description: This file defines a class 'NodePairingApprovalPrompter' responsible for managing node pairing approval prompts within a macOS app. It handles loading pending requests, presenting alerts, managing approval/rejection workflows, resolving pairing requests, and conducting silent SSH approvals. It communicates with a gateway for listing, approving, and rejecting node pairing requests, and manages in-app notifications and dialogs.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing node pairing approval prompts, handling request loading, alert presentation, approval/rejection workflows, and network interactions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the prompting and reconciling process.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing tasks, clears states, and resets counts.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Loads pending pairing requests asynchronously from the gateway with retries.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Periodically reconciles requests to keep state in sync across applications.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a list of pairing requests to update internal queues and detect state changes.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pairing request alert if conditions allow.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing confirmation alert to the user.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user response to the pairing alert, proceeding with approval or rejection accordingly.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends an approval for a pairing request to the gateway.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends rejection for a pairing request to the gateway.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends in-app notifications about pairing resolution outcomes.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to silently approve a pairing request if conditions are met, including SSH probe.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Resolves SSH target info from settings or network discovery for silent approval.
